## [My order still hasn't shipped...](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64af300a706f837cb10eccb3)
My order still hasn't shipped.....I made my order on July 4. The item was listed as in stock and expected to arrive within 7-10 days of shipment. The item still has not shipped and suddenly the website says there is a waitlist for the item because it is out of stock. I received no email from L&G saying anything about the item being out of stock, updating my order, or giving me any other information. This is my second purchase on L&G and the second time this exact situation has occurred.

July 5, 2023
